lines: Swift played 78% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 64% on the season, and averaged 20.3 carries a game versus 17.2 for the year.
Coach Ben Johnson said Swift will keep getting the carries near the goal line. Swift has scored 10 total TDs this season.
In Week 11 he faces NO, who allow the 2nd-most PPR points per game to RBs. CHI's implied team total is 30.0 points.
